notes: Positive Premier Cru climat claim rules for Pernand-Vergelesses and Auxey-Duresses. Pernand has an explicit color matrix: Sous Frétille, Clos Berthet and Village de Pernand are white-only; the remaining five may be claimed for white or red. All nine Auxey-Duresses Premier Cru climats are claimable for both colors under the corresponding Premier Cru production rules.

rules.notes: All eight enumerated Pernand-Vergelesses Premier Cru climat names are valid for white wine meeting Premier Cru conditions.
Red Premier Cru claims are limited to the five climats authorized for red; Sous Frétille, Clos Berthet and Village de Pernand are white-only.
All nine enumerated Auxey-Duresses Premier Cru climat names are valid for both white and red wines satisfying the corresponding Premier Cru production specification.
